title: Semiconductor Doping
description: A few atoms in a million of boron or phosphorus make silicon conduct, one way or the other; where the two meet, a junction. Unlocks the Doping Furnace.

puzzle.goal: A dopant diffuses into silicon with diffusion constant D for a time t. Write the depth x it reaches.
puzzle.name: Junction depth
puzzle.ask: Find x in centimetres for D = @{D} cm²/s and t = @{t} s.
puzzle.method: A random walk spreads as the square root of time.
